payload: df -hT -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs -x squashfs; lsblk -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MOUNTPOINT
awk -F: '$7 !~ /(nologin|false|sync|halt|shutdown)$/ {print $1, $3, $6, $7}' /etc/passwd; getent group sudo admin wheel; ls -l /etc/sudoers.d/ 2>&1
ls -l /etc/cron.d /etc/cron.daily /etc/cron.hourly /etc/cron.weekly 2>&1; grep -v '^#' /etc/crontab | grep -v '^$'; crontab -l 2>&1; systemctl list-timers --all --no-pager --no-legend
